messages.subject: what is (dur_day_total_MOD_min)
parts:
Dears, I have two "basic" questions. When I read the discerption for 

dur_day_total_MOD_min
(Total duration of day in minutes of moderate activity during the day) is that the mean during all days of it is the sum of moderate activity ? 

2nd question, what does GGIR stand for ? I remember seeing it before but I can't find it now. sorry if my questions seems very basic !

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] what is (dur_day_total_MOD_min)
parts:
Hi Maher, see my answers below:


‐‐‐‐‐‐‐ Original Message ‐‐‐‐‐‐‐

On Tuesday, June 8th, 2021 at 03:08, Maher AL-Quaimi <malq...@gmail.com> wrote:

Dears, I have two "basic" questions. When I read the discerption for 

dur_day_total_MOD_min
(Total duration of day in minutes of moderate activity during the day) is that the mean during all days of it is the sum of moderate activity ?

The daysummary report only shows totals and averages per recording day.
The person summary report shows the averages of day-level variables across recordings days. None of these variables tries to tell you the total time spent per week or per recording. However, you can derive this by multiplying the person level variables related to time-use to get the weekly totals. Multiple by 7 if it refers to average of all days, by 5 for variables specific to weekdays, or by 2 for variables specific to weekend days.
2nd question, what does GGIR stand for ? I remember seeing it before but I can't find it now. sorry if my questions seems very basic !

See: https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/GGIR/vignettes/GGIR.html#59_What_does_GGIR_stand_for
